page.$description: The page background, sitting behind all other content

raised.$description: Cards, panels and anything sitting above the page

sunken.$description: Wells and insets that recede below the page, such as a code block

overlay.$description: The surface of popovers, dropdowns, menus and tooltips

scrim.$description: The dim backdrop behind a modal or drawer

primary.$description: Body copy and headings — the default text colour

secondary.$description: Supporting text a step below body in emphasis

muted.$description: De-emphasised text: hints, placeholders and timestamps

inverse.$description: Text for the theme's inverse surface; flips with the mode (light in light mode, dark in dark), so use it only over a theme surface, not a fixed background

link.$description: Hyperlinks and other inline navigational text

default.$description: The default border for cards, inputs and dividers

subtle.$description: A faint divider where a full border would be too heavy

strong.$description: A prominent border for emphasis or a selected state

focus.$description: The colour of the keyboard focus ring on interactive elements

background.$description: Buttons, links and other primary actions

foreground.$description: Text and icons sitting on a primary action

hover.$description: A primary action's background while hovered

active.$description: A primary action's background while pressed

foreground.$description: Text and icons on a secondary action

hover.$description: A secondary action's background while hovered

active.$description: A secondary action's background while pressed

background.$description: Low-emphasis buttons with no fill until interacted with, such as toolbar and icon buttons

foreground.$description: Text and icons of a ghost button

hover.$description: A ghost button's background while hovered

active.$description: A ghost button's background while pressed

background.$description: Buttons that delete or perform irreversible actions

foreground.$description: Text and icons on a destructive button

hover.$description: A destructive button's background while hovered

active.$description: A destructive button's background while pressed

background.$description: The background of a disabled control

foreground.$description: Text and icons of a disabled control

background.$description: The surface of an informational alert, badge or banner

foreground.$description: Text and icons within an informational alert or badge

background.$description: The surface of a success alert, badge or banner

foreground.$description: Text and icons within a success alert or badge

background.$description: The surface of a warning alert, badge or banner

foreground.$description: Text and icons within a warning alert or badge

background.$description: The surface of an error or danger alert, badge or banner

foreground.$description: Text and icons within an error or danger alert or badge

padding-x.$description: Horizontal padding inside buttons, inputs and other controls

padding-y.$description: Vertical padding inside buttons, inputs and other controls

padding.$description: Padding inside cards, panels and containers

gap.$description: The gap between items in a stack or group

section.$description: Vertical gaps between major page sections

control.$description: Buttons, inputs, selects and other interactive controls

pill.$description: Fully rounded elements like tags, chips and avatars

raised.$description: Cards and panels lifted just above the page

modal.$description: Modals and dialogs sitting above a scrim

sticky.$description: Headers and bars that stay put while the page scrolls

control.$description: Border width for inputs, buttons and other controls

focus-ring.$description: Width of the keyboard focus ring

focus-offset.$description: Gap between an element and its focus ring

1.$description: The main page title — one per page

bodySmall.$description: Secondary body text a step smaller than body

lead.$description: Introductory or standfirst text, larger than body

code.$description: Inline code and code blocks, in a monospace family
